tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. A cool linen, never cream. In Night watch it is the stage and lyrics background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, form inputs, the song chart sheet.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card borders. Not for input borders (use line-strong).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, 3:1 or better on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised, and the soft tints.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions, verse references. 4.5:1 or better on every surface and tint.

tokens.name: tekhelet
tokens.usage: The brand blue, named for the biblical blue dye. Links, secondary buttons, chords in charts, key UI. As text on surface, surface-raised, or tekhelet-soft.

tokens.name: tekhelet-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: song key pills, selected nav item, info panels. Pair with tekhelet or ink text.

tokens.name: on-tekhelet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tekhelet fill.

tokens.name: pomegranate
tokens.usage: The one main call to action per view (Join the team, Send application). Never for messages or errors.

tokens.name: on-pomegranate
tokens.usage: Label text on a pomegranate button.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Thin details only: Selah dividers, hairline ornaments, the rule in the logo. Passes 4.5:1 for the small Selah mark on surface; never for body text.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Success and confirmed status. As text on surface-raised or olive-soft, always with a word or icon, never color alone.

tokens.name: olive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of confirmed badges and success messages.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and declined status, always with an icon and message text. Kept separate from pomegranate.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error messages and declined badges.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Footer and full-bleed dark bands on the public site.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on night.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. An alias of tekhelet.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, underlined. An alias of tekhelet.

families.display: "Frank Ruhl Libre", "Noto Serif Hebrew", Georgia, serif

styles.name: wordmark-he
styles.usage: The Hebrew word in the home hero. Once per site, set with lang="he" dir="rtl".

styles.name: verse
styles.sample: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD.
styles.usage: Scripture quotes. 20px on phones. Reference below in caption.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, song titles, portal headings.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We lead the church in singing every Sunday.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rehearsal starts at 4:00 PM on Saturday.

styles.name: chord
styles.usage: Chord names above lyrics in charts, in tekhelet.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: pill padding, chord to lyric.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between related sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop, hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, key pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, the hero image, the app icon proportion.

stroke.note: Line weights. The brand uses lines, not shadows, like the strings of a lyre.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, Selah divider lines.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring and the selected nav underline.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of paragraphs and song charts.
